correctness.rationale: Necessity and sufficiency of a path word with distance-two-separated equal colors and odd nonempty color classes are established by inspecting all neighbor types in the join. Rigorous parity and three-color periodicity give sharp lower bounds; six explicitly checked seeds plus the length-six oddness-preserving insertion supply universal upper bounds. For n<=6 no triple repetition can fit. The proof covers all r,n>=1, including endpoints and n=1. Direct neighborhood enumeration n<=12 and parity-mask DP n<=80 match but are not used to extrapolate beyond finite checks.

value.rationale: Caro et al. singled out one fan K_1 join P_6 as a sharp outerplanar lower-bound witness. Completing the natural entire fan family gives a nontrivial phase transition from all-distinct colors through the sharp sequence 7,6,5,4 and an exactly periodic regime; the number of required colors is not monotone as the path length increases. This is a motivated natural infinite-family classification for an active graph-coloring parameter. The clique-path corollary reuses the proof and is merged into this single claim rather than treated as separate routine research.
